latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Pixabay Music AB2N — Add royalty-free music to videos:

- Instantly add royalty-free Pixabay music to your uploaded videos without copyright worries.
- Supports quick video upload (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and 1080p MP4 downloads.
- Automatic backend connection and user authentication with a free token system.
- Includes workflows for editing, credits checks, exports, and state previews.
- Designed for fast, remote GPU processing—no software installation needed.
